'Publishing is the irreversible boundary.' wrangler.toml shows Cloudflare runs builder/build.py and serves generated/, so a push to a connected branch can itself trigger a deploy.

3. Verify after merging: grep -c 'iv-therapy\|morpheus8\|hydrafacial\|chemical-peel\|dermal-fillers' builder/build.py should be 25, and grep -c 'rel="canonical"' templates/treatment-page.html.j2 should be 1. If either is 0, the merge ate them again.

items.summary: Two borderline businesses were handled inconsistently and the rule should be yours, not the builder's.
items.detail: XO Salon & Spa (sunny-isles-beach) was DROPPED because its primary Google category is a hair salon, even though its own menu names lip filler and it runs a physician-injector med-spa arm. Pink Beauty Lounge (sunny-isles-beach) was KEPT because it has a dedicated HydraFacial MD page with published prices — but it also sells hair, nails, lashes and brows. Nefertiti Spa (plantation) is a 'spa' selling chemical peels and plasma microneedling. All three are the same species of edge case.
items.decision_needed: Define the inclusion rule: medical-supervision required? primary Google category must be medical? or any business that verifiably performs the treatment?
items.consequence: A strict rule removes Pink Beauty Lounge and Nefertiti Spa and re-opens 3 pages. A loose rule re-admits XO Salon.
items.resolution: Operator decision (Rolando, via Cowork, 2026-08-18): KEEP the clinics as listed. Pink Beauty Lounge, Nefertiti Spa and Skin Lounge stay. Rule going forward: a business qualifies if it verifiably performs the treatment on its own published menu, regardless of whether it also sells hair/nails/lashes. XO Salon & Spa was dropped earlier under the stricter reading and may be re-added on a future pass.

items.summary: CoolSculpting is one of five original active treatments but accounts for 13 of the 30 remaining one-short pages. Field study says the brand has been displaced in independent med spas.
items.evidence: Across south-beach, coral-gables, kendall and pembroke-pines, only 1-3 of ~10 clinics per city name CoolSculpting on their own website. Independents have re-tooled to Emsculpt/Emsculpt Neo, Morpheus8, Evolve, VelaShape and GLP-1 injectables. CoolSculpting now sits mainly with dermatology practices and national chains (Ideal Image, LaserAway).
items.consequence: Most coolsculpting city pages will stay one short no matter how much prospecting is done. This is a market fact, not a data gap.
items.recommendation: Swap coolsculpting for morpheus8 in config/thresholds.json seed_scope.categories['med-spa'].treatments. morpheus8 definitions are already restored in build.py and it appeared at clinics in all four tested cities. HARD-GATED — operator only.
items.counter_argument: CoolSculpting still has real search demand even where supply is thin; keeping it costs nothing except pages that never build. Dropping it removes an honest empty category. Your call.
